title: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 66

sections.shortTitle: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 66
sections.section: ORDER - Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979, No. 66
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
By
CHIEF MARTIAL LAW
ADMINISTRATORS
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 16th April 1979]
No. 66
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 30th April, 1979]
1.-(1) This Martial Law Order shall come into force
at once and shall take effect notwithstanding anything to the contrary
contained in any other law for the time being in force.
(2) It shall extend to the areas specified in
Schedule I.
2. In this Martial Law Order, unless there is
anything repugnant in the subject or context:-
(a) "Commissioner" means the Commissioner,
Peshawar Division ;
(b) "Council" means the Council of Elders
appointed by the Commis sioner under this Martial Law Order ;
(c) "specified dispute" means a dispute
specified in Schedule II ; and
(d) "Governor" means the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province.
3.--(1) The Commissioner shall refer a specified
dispute to a Council and require the Council to come to a finding on the
matters in dispute after making such enquiry as may be necessary and after
hearing the parties.
(2) The order of reference made under sub-paragraph
(I) shall state the matter or matters in dispute on which the finding of the
Council is required.
(3) The Commissioner, on receipt of the finding of
the Council, may-
(a) Pass a decree in accordance with the unanimous
finding of the Council or of not less than three-fourths of the members thereof
; or
(b) remand the case to the Council for a further
finding ; or
(c) refer the dispute to a second Council for a
further finding thereon ; and, in either of the two latter cases, may pass a
decree in accordance with the unanimous finding of the Council or of not less
than three-fourths of the members thereof.
(4) In any proceedings before the Council, the
parties may engage and be represented by a legal practitioner.
4.-(1) Subject to the order of the Governor on an
appeal under sub paragraph (2), a decree passed by the Commissioner shall be
final.
(2) An appeal shall lie to the Governor against an
order of the Commis sioner under sub-paragraph (1) of paragraph 3 constituting
the Council or a decree passed by the Commissioner under sub-paragraph (3) of
that paragraph; and the decision of the Governor on such appeal shall be final.
(3) Where any proceedings are pending before the
Commissioner or the Governor, the Commissioner or, as the case may be, the
Governor may, on the application of either of the parties, pass such interim
orders, pending the passing of the final decree or order as he may deem fit.
(4) Except as provided in sub-paragraph (3), no Court
or other authority shall grant an injunction or make an interim order in
relation to any matter which the Commissioner has referred to a Council under
paragraph 3.
5. All suits, appeals and applications pending in any
civil Court immediately before the commencement of this Order in respect of a
matter in dispute which the Commissioner has referred to a Council under
paragraph 3 shall, in so far as they relate to such matter, abate forthwith.
6. The Evidence Act, 1872 (1 of 1872), and the
Limitation Act, 1908 (IX of 1908), shall not apply to any proceedings under
this Martial Law Order.
7.-(1) The Governor may, by notification in the
official Gazette, make rules for carrying out the purposes of this Martial Law
Order.
(2) In particular and without prejudice to the
generality of the foregoing power, such rules may provide for-
(a) the constitution of the Council and the manner in
which it shall con duct its proceedings ; and
(b) the mode and manner in which a decree passed by
the Commissioner under this Martial Law Order shall be executed.
SCHEDULE I
1. Kohat District.
2. Orakzai Agency.
3. Kurram Agency.
SCHEDULE II
Specified dispute.
1. Boundary dispute between Mohammadzaiwals of Kohat
District and Bezoti tribe of Orakzai Agency.
2. Boundary dispute between the inhabitants of
village Kachai, Tehsil Hangu, District Kohat and Sheikhan tribe of Orakzai
Agency.
